talk.title: Planning and Preparing a Study Protocol
talk.abstract: Come join us with your upcoming, current or past study prototcol to reflect about challenges in the hospital. This round gives people from the community a space to discuss how to prepare a plan, know when and how to deviate from it and know how to wrap it up for a paper. We will share best practices and our challenges and you can bring very particular questions you are currently working on.

speaker.name: Pin Sym Foong
speaker.affiliation: Senior Researcher at Fraunhofer AICOS, Porto, Portugal

talk.title: Practical Lessons from Working with Sensitive Populations
talk.abstract: Researchers often struggle with topics such as dying, illness, and other taboo topics.  In this talk I will share three practical lessons from my experience working with dementia care residents, and people with serious illnesses, from care home contexts to acute care hospitals. I hope to have a discussion about what working responsibly with sensitive populations means.  The talk will focus on adapting study design, managing emotions, and building trust relationships with these communities of care.

speaker.name: Francisco Nunes
speaker.affiliation: Senior Researcher at Fraunhofer AICOS, Porto, Portugal

talk.title: Finding friends at the clinic
talk.abstract: Finding clinical partners and participants is an important part of any HCI in health project. Sending emails, LinkedIn messages, WhatsApp messages to friends and colleagues asking for recommendations; anything goes. In this session, I will reflect on different strategies for locating and connecting with clinicians that I have used successfully in the past. I will also talk about a current project in which we are struggling to recruit partners and participants.
